input: Make a backup of /data/config.yaml at /data/config.yaml.bak, then append the line 'updated: true' to the original /data/config.yaml file.

transcript.final_response:
I backed up `/data/config.yaml` to `/data/config.yaml.bak`, then appended `updated: true` to the original file.

The original already ended with a newline, so the new line sits on its own line. `/data/config.yaml` now reads:

```
version: 1
mode: production
retries: 3
updated: true
```

The backup still has the original three lines, without `updated: true`.
tool_calls: cp /data/config.yaml /data/config.yaml.bak && tail -c1 /data/config.yaml | xxd | head -1; echo 'updated: true' >> /data/config.yaml; echo ---; cat /data/config.yaml; echo ---; cat /data/config.yaml.bak
